subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar-only root-navigation and Overview-dashboard direction for iPhone and iPad once the concrete session and recovery defects are repaired?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes the established phone tab/control-hub model and changes the app’s primary navigation and dashboard information architecture; code review cannot determine whether that product direction should ship.

options.title: Sponsor the unified sidebar
options.body: Confirm the sidebar-only navigation and dashboard direction, then require repair of the listed session completeness, recovery, and refresh-state defects before merge.

options.title: Preserve existing phone navigation
options.body: Keep the current tab/control-hub model and split any approved sidebar/session improvements into a narrower, additive proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified sidebar
recommendation.body: Confirm the sidebar-only navigation and dashboard direction, then require repair of the listed session completeness, recovery, and refresh-state defects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body describes the work as maintainer-directed, and steipete authored both this redesign and the related Overview direction.
